title: Woodland Adventurers: Free Forest School for Children
description: Join us at Woodland Adventurers, a fantastic, free forest school for children. Filled with woodland skills, conservation crafts, wildlife spotting, and hands-on learning about the natural world.

title: Tunbridge Wells Common Volunteering Session
location: Fir Tree Road Car Park, Tunbridge Wells Common (TN4 8AH)
description: Practical scrub clearance, removing invasive species, clearing paths and ponds, and litter picking across Tunbridge Wells Common. Meeting in Fir Tree Road car park. All equipment, gloves, and guidance provided.

title: Woodland Adventurers: Free Forest School for Children
description: Our December forest school session on Rusthall Common. Curious young explorers can build woodland skills, discover winter wildlife, make seasonal crafts, and connect with nature.

title: Rusthall Common Volunteering Session
location: Outside St Paul’s Church / Happy Valley Entrance, Rusthall Common
description: Lend a helping hand caring for Rusthall Common! Join our friendly work party for scrub management, clearing encroaching growth around pathways, pond care, and litter picking.
